title: Awesome Autumn Jamaican Beef Burger
description: A kid-friendly Jamaican dish featuring salty and springy beef burgers served on sesame seed buns, caramelized to perfection and wrapped in a banana leaf, this recipe is egg-free-friendly and perfect for a fun family meal
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined
Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each into a ball, then flatten slightly into patties
Brush the grill or grill pan with vegetable oil to prevent sticking
Grill the beef patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit
While the burgers are cooking, caramelize the onion in a pan with a little vegetable oil over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally
Toast the sesame seed buns on the grill or in a toaster
Assemble the burgers by spreading a toasted bun with caramelized onion, then topping with a beef patty
Wrap each burger in a banana leaf and serve immediately
